assets.title: Карнавал Заводных Масок
assets.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as cover.png in the current directory.
Wide landscape key art, 3:2. A huge walking casino the size of a town hall, a tiered wedding-cake palace of copper, teal lacquer and striped awnings, strides along a festive fairground road on eight tall jointed copper legs with visible gears at the knees and ankles. Bunting and ribbons trail from its balconies, masked guests wave from windows, a red lacquered clockwork goose bows on a turntable above the main gate. Far ahead on the horizon, a low copper boundary line of posts and a toll arch marks a border. In the foreground, at a ribbon market with stalls and a painted wagon, a small mixed crew of eight adventurers (two armoured fighters, two nimble rogues, two clerics with holy symbols, two wizards) stand looking up as the giant foot lands just beside the stalls, cups and hats flying. Late afternoon golden light, sense of scale and comic grandeur.

Recurring details: gears and cogs, festive half-masks, a red lacquered clockwork goose. Mischief, wit and warm humanity; no horror, no gore, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism.
